description.narrative:
The project directly contributes to Danmission’s Peace & Democracy Myanmar Country Programme, specifically Impact Goal 2, which seeks to strengthen social cohesion and resilience in conflict-affected communities across Kachin and Northern Shan States. It advances Outcome 2 (Resilience) by empowering women, youth, and other vulnerable groups to enhance their psychosocial resilience and participate meaningfully in community life.
Through the establishment of safe spaces, the facilitation of trauma-informed dialogue, and the promotion of both inter- and intra-ethnic and faith-based engagement, the project fosters trust, social inclusion, and collaborative action across diverse communities. By strengthening local capacities for peacebuilding and enabling communities to respond to conflict in constructive and resilient ways, the project contributes to sustainable peace, social cohesion, and long-term community resilience.
